channel.title: Muster Agent blog
channel.description: Practical guides on coding agents from the Muster team.

item.title: How to prompt coding agents well
item.description: How to prompt coding agents: state the goal, give the right context, set constraints, define acceptance checks and leave out what does not help.

item.title: Getting coding agents to use tools well
item.description: How to get coding agents to use the terminal, the browser and MCP servers well, and how to choose permissions so that capable does not mean careless.

item.title: Sandboxing coding agents with Muster Agent
item.description: How to contain a coding agent: permission modes, disposable sandboxes, scoped computers and keeping secrets out of commands, with Muster Agent.

item.title: Running agents on your own server with Muster Server
item.description: What Muster Server runs, how to deploy it, how the desktop app connects, how teams use it, and what is not built yet. An honest guide for self-hosting.

item.title: Using any model through routers with Muster Agent
item.description: How to use any model through an OpenAI-compatible router such as OmniRoute, OpenRouter or LiteLLM, choose models per task, and read cost receipts.

item.title: Doing Paperclip tasks locally with Muster Agent
item.description: Check out a Paperclip task, work in a git worktree and let the work hand itself back, with what Muster Agent actually does.

item.title: Reviewing coding agent changes safely
item.description: How to review what a coding agent changed: read small diffs, keep or undo per file, check the evidence and keep receipts, with Muster Agent features.

item.title: Parallel agents and sub-agents: when to split work
item.description: When to run agents in parallel, when to use sub-agents, and how to keep the work reviewable, plus how Muster Agent handles overlap and worktrees.

item.title: What is an AI Development Environment (ADE)?
item.description: The anchor guide: what an ADE is, when you want one, what to look for, and how Muster Agent approaches it.
